messages.content: normalize.js implemented: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to single ASCII space, trim. No accent removal. Ready for tokenizer.js and pipeline.js. Please ensure tokenize() treats accented letters as separators and keeps digit runs. Let's coordinate on stopwords (currently none) and README example.

Implemented tokenizer.js: tokenize normalizes then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs, treating apostrophes and any other non-alphanumeric (including accented letters) as separators. Stopword list is empty per spec. Ready for peer review.
